content.title: India's microfinance sector seek up to $2.2 billion credit guarantee support from government, official says
content.summary: MUMBAI (Reuters) -India's microfinance industry has sought credit guarantee support of up to 200 billion rupees ($2.2 billion) from the government to spur loan growth in a sector grappling with higher borrowing costs, senior industry officials said on Tuesday.  The Microfinance Industry Network has sought up to 75% default guarantee coverage from the union government on bank loans to microfinance institutions, Alok Misra, CEO of the self-regulatory organisation for the sector, told reporters at a press conference.
